content.summary: An adult cook turns six eggs into twelve filled appetizers through five visible operations. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult craftsperson and one workshop persist. + Each craft stage visibly changes the object. + Decoration follows a stable vessel state. + The group shot proves a finished series. + Hand washing follows and confirms the completed process.
quick_start.recommended_input: One original clearly adult animated cook halves six cooked eggs on one blue board. Add one spoon of herb dressing and mix until the yolks become one smooth filling. Add one red and one green garnish pass, then pull wide to prove all twelve finished halves on one tray.

invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Counts remain consistent from halves to tray."
